answer: An agent marketplace coordinating terrace repairs, orchard care, and reef monitoring requires each voting identity to lock $100 in escrow for 30 days, with one vote per identity per round and no reuse of locked funds across accounts. Creating names is cheap, but controlling 1,000 votes ties up $100,000 for a month. This does not eliminate wealthy attackers; it makes voting power depend on committed capital instead of free identities.
